name: Blank black leather flight jacket name tag
size_basis: Proportion read from Fig A6-3 (about 2.0 : 1, same as the flight suit tag); size taken as 2 x 4 in. CAPR 39-1 gives no jacket-tag dimension.
provenance: in-house construction from Fig A6-3 (flight suit name tags): shape, border, stitch only, no lettering
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in): name line (first and last name), grade lower left ("Cadet" for all cadets), "CAP" lower right, up to two badges (CAP aeronautical rating / occupational / mission qualification) above the name (8.2.4.1)

lines.content: grade ("Cadet" for cadets; NCO grade for NCOs; none printed on the officer cloth tag)

assumed: zone positions read from Fig A6-3
fastener: sewn or hook and loop on the jacket
